metadata.title: Final Summary
metadata.purposeAndUsage: Provide a final comprehensive summary of an investigation that consolidates all previous steps into a clear, actionable conclusion. Use to conclude an investigation process.

prerequisites: Data available in memory from previous steps
specificActions: Read all investigation data from previous steps in memory
Handle all scenarios: no issues, issues not fixed, issues fixed

read: process.md (context parameters if not in memory)
update: memory.json (current step section with summary path and conclusion)

tools: read_file - Read memory.json, process.md, report files
bestPractices: Read systematically from all previous steps in memory.json
Gather complete information before compiling summary
Organize summary sections logically and clearly
Ensure conclusion is clear and actionable

substeps.name: Init-Step: Confirm Principles
substeps.description: Recall operating principles before starting this step
actions: Read `.processes/steps/_components/operating-principles.md` and recall all principles
Output: '✓ Principles confirmed for this step'

substeps.name: Read All Previous Steps from Memory
substeps.description: Gather all investigation data from previous steps
actions: Read all step sections from memory.json
Gather: scope, files reviewed, findings, issues, fixes, verification status
Log: 'Gathered data from {count} previous steps'

substeps.name: Read Any Report Files
substeps.description: Read detailed reports if they exist
actions: Read findings-report.md, issues-list.json, fix-proposals.md if they exist
Extract detailed information for summary

substeps.name: Compile Investigation Data
substeps.description: Organize information and determine overall status
actions: Organize information by section
Determine overall status (no issues, issues found, issues fixed)
Prepare content for each summary section

substeps.name: Create Final Summary Document
substeps.description: Create comprehensive summary document with all sections
actions: Create final-summary.md with sections:
Executive Summary, Investigation Scope, Files Reviewed, Findings Summary
Issues Found (if any), Fixes Applied (if any), Final Verification Status
Remaining Issues (if any), Recommendations (if any), Conclusion
Log: 'Created final-summary.md'

substeps.name: Present Summary to User
substeps.description: Present summary and highlight key findings
actions: Present final-summary.md to user
Highlight key findings and conclusion

substeps.name: Update Memory
substeps.description: Update memory with summary path and conclusion
actions: Write to memory.json: Final summary document path, Overall conclusion, Final verification status, Recommendations

substeps.name: End-Step: Compliance Check
substeps.description: Verify principles were followed in this step
actions: Verify: Was log.json updated for any user interactions?
Verify: Were mandatory actions confirmed with output?
Verify: Do modified process files conform to type definitions? (Principle 7 - see `.processes/steps/_components/operating-principles.md`)
Output: '✓ Step completed in compliance with operating principles'

flow.description: Read all previous steps → Read report files → Compile data → Determine scenario → Create summary document → Present to user → Update memory

memoryFileUsage.readFrom: All previous step sections in memory.json (scope, files, findings, issues, fixes, verification)
fields: Information Produced: Final summary document path, Overall conclusion, Final verification status, Recommendations
